# Autumn Light

Golden leaves drift down like scattered thoughts,
Each one a memory the wind has caught.
The trees stand bare against the fading sky,
As summer's warmth prepares to say goodbye.
Yet in this quiet loss, there's beauty found—
The earth receives what falls without a sound.
